title: ONS, Consumer price inflation updating weights: 2027 + the CPI basket article (09:30 London / 05:30 ET) — the venue where the 2027 electricity weight three ledgers depend on actually becomes public, nine days before the print that applies it
source: EST: date DERIVED, not published — ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationupdatingweights2027 returns HTTP 404 as of 2026-09-10, so ONS has not yet diarised the 2027 edition. The derivation is ONS's own ten-year record, read direct 2026-09-10 from the article's previousreleases index (ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/consumerpriceinflationupdatingweights/previousreleases, HTTP 200) against the February-index publication dates from the CPI bulletin archive (HTTP 200 each): 2018 19 Mar/20 Mar (1d), 2019 18 Mar/20 Mar (2d), 2020 19 Mar/25 Mar (6d), 2021 15 Mar/24 Mar (9d), 2022 14 Mar/23 Mar (9d), 2023 13 Mar/22 Mar (9d), 2024 11 Mar/20 Mar (9d), 2025 18 Mar/26 Mar (8d), 2026 16 Mar/25 Mar (9d). The article has preceded the February print in 10 of 10 years and by 8-9 days in the last six, on the MONDAY nine days before the Wednesday print in five of those six (2025 is the lone Tuesday, 8d). February 2027 CPI is ONS-Provisional for Wednesday 2027-03-24, so gap-9 fits Monday 2027-03-15 and gap-8 fits Tuesday 2027-03-16. Time from ONS's own 2026 release page, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200): 'Consumer price inflation, updating weights: 2026 / Released: 16 March 2026 9:30am' — 09:30 London, NOT the bulletin's 07:00. Discovered 2026-09-10 during the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-03-24
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-03-24 LANE, 2026-09-10, BECAUSE THE DATE THREE LEDGERS NOW POINT AT IS STILL NINE DAYS LATE FOR THE THING THEY WANT. The chain so far: uk-cpi-2027-11-17, uk-cpi-2027-05-19 and uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 all diarised 2027-02-17 as the date the 2027 CPI electricity weight (MM23 CJXA) resolves; the uk-cpi-2027-02-17 lane refuted that on ONS's double-update methodology and re-pointed everything at the February print on 2027-03-24; this lane re-derived that from ONS's technical manual and agrees. But 'published with the February index' is a statement about where the weights are APPLIED. The NUMBER becomes public earlier, in this article and its class-level Annex A Tables W1-W3 — the same annex the uk-cpi-2027-02-17 lane parsed to establish the 6-of-6 CJXA match, whose 2026 edition published 16 March 2026, nine days before the 25 March 2026 print. So a forward test that names the CJXA VALUE (FT-uk-cpi-2027-11-17-3, re-dated once already) can be scored on this date; a forward test that names the MM23 SERIES carrying it should stay on 2027-03-24, because MM23 updates with the bulletin. Both readings are defensible and they are nine days apart — which is the whole reason this entry exists rather than a footnote. THIS ENTRY ALSO CARRIES THE BASKET ARTICLE: ONS's February 2026 bulletin, fetched direct 2026-09-10, says 'We published our Consumer price inflation, updating weights: 2026 and our Consumer price inflation basket of goods and services: 2026 articles on 16 March 2026' — one date, two articles. STATUS IS estimate ON TWO INDEPENDENT COUNTS, not one: ONS has published no 2027 date at all (404), and even the sibling February print it is derived from is itself ONS-Provisional. The confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for ONS in any case. TREAT THE DAY-OF-WEEK AS THE FIRMER HALF OF THE CLAIM: the 8-9 day band is 6 for 6 since 2021 and 10 for 10 directionally since 2017, but the exact Monday is 5 of 6. If ONS diarises the 2027 edition on a date outside 2027-03-15..2027-03-17, this file is wrong and the owning lane should say so rather than widen the band after the fact. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a tradable event. symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, no rates- or FX-keyed house playbook, and a 05:30 ET methodology article about index weights has no channel into a book of eight US mega-caps. Tiered LOW to match every UK entry here. Its value is entirely as a research-calendar correction: it is where a number four ledgers' kill switches are cut from can first be read. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
